negative_reviews.author: Liuchang MA
negative_reviews.text:
Really disappointing experience. Both bowls of ramen were incredibly salty, and the black garlic oil ramen was overwhelmingly greasy with barely any aroma or flavour. Honestly, it just wasn’t enjoyable to eat.

Service wasn’t much better — the table was sticky and we waited ages just to pay the bill.

Such a shame, as my first visit here was completely different and I really enjoyed it then.

negative_reviews.author: James Tester
negative_reviews.text: Appalling slow and clueless service, eating implements, glasses, water drinks etc all had to be asked for multiple times after being ‘ignored’ for over half an hour. When food finally came the ramen soup dishes we ordered were not the quality of ramen we expect (eating ramen in restaurants many many times). On the plus side the maki rolls were good. We had a 50% discount code which tempered the disappointment, but had we paid full price I might be leaving a somewhat more scathing review.

negative_reviews.author: Alexandra Racheru
negative_reviews.text:
The entrance is like a hallway from a horror video game. There is no one at the upper(street level) entrance at the reception.
You walk down into what looks like it can be the beginning of the murder mystery.
Once you get downstairs alive, you are greeted quickly by the staff which were nice.
During the entire time we were there the ladies restroom had a paper on the door with a very “professional” hand written note: “Cleaning in progress” - at a restaurant this should not be out of order for longer than 15 min maximum.
However it did not seem the have anyone cleaning so I pushed the door to enter because I want to wash my hands before eating, surprisingly there was no one cleaning anywhere. There are 6 toilets - 1st one had the door opened full of cleaning supplies in a very disorganised and dirty way, the 2nd & 3rd toilet were both Out of order with yet another very proper hand write note on them.

Out of the other 3 toiles left - 2 were in an unusable state and only 1 was not completely gross and could be used.

The food was mediocre at best, we were 3 people, we got 3 mains and 1 starter.
They did serve the food very quickly- which makes you wonder a bit, however it was basic at best for some classic dishes.

We paid around 25£ each and we will not return.
I do not and will never recommend a place that does not keep their restroom clean.
Unacceptable for central London!
